I Paid $40… But It Felt Like a $130 Experience
Aug 2026 • Family
For just $40, I honestly didn’t expect much. A 14-course meal with teppanyaki Wagyu at this price sounded almost too good to be true.

I’ve had Wagyu teppanyaki in Japan before, where a similar experience cost me around ¥20,000 (over $130). Surprisingly, this meal didn’t feel like a budget version at all.

The quality, the variety, and the overall experience far exceeded what I expected for the price. It’s one of those rare places where you genuinely feel like you’re getting much more than what you paid for. If you’re looking for incredible value without sacrificing the experience, this is absolutely worth trying.

Must try teppanyaki n sushi spot 30usd only
Jan 2026 • Couples
I visited the restaurant last Tuesday. The space is tucked away on the first floor at 87 Yersin Street — small, but very clean and comfortable.

I tried the 800k set menu. It included sashimi (raw fish), but the chef can lightly sear or cook it if you’re not used to eating raw dishes. We also had a steamed course, and the highlight of the meal was the Wagyu beef cooked teppanyaki-style. The beef was incredibly tender, melting in the mouth, with a rich and flavorful taste.

The whole experience made me feel like I was in the heart of Tokyo, dining in a cozy little alley restaurant.

Highly recommend.

A bath of pleasures with many highlights
Aug 2025 • Family
A bath of pleasures with many highlights. Everything perfectly arranged. Every sushi is made with love and an explosion of taste takes place in the mouth. There is a great selection of dishes and you can watch the chefs prepare the food directly. Great Mood in a family atmosphere.
We had an absolute culinary experience today! Even the first impression was great – the food was served with great attention to detail and immediately made you want more. 
The sushi was of excellent quality: incredibly fresh, tender and excellently matched in taste – a delight that melts on the tongue. Another highlight was the buttery Wagyu beef mignon: perfectly prepared, wonderfully aromatic and simply a masterpiece. The foie gras was also a treat. 
Each course was a small work of art in its own right, both taste and appearance.
Overall, a menu at the highest level, which has inspired all around. For those who appreciate fine cuisine and exceptional quality, an absolute recommendation!

Hidden Gem in Ho Chi Minh – A Must-Try Teppanyaki Experience
Jun 2025 • Business
What a fantastic experience! This small teppanyaki restaurant may not look like much from the outside, but it’s truly a hidden gem. The chefs are incredibly skilled, and their attention to detail is just perfect. From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring – they really go above and beyond to make guests feel welcome and special.

The food was fresh, expertly cooked right in front of us, and absolutely delicious. Every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. You can feel the passion and pride in every plate.

Highly recommended if you’re in Ho Chi Minh and looking for an unforgettable dining experience. This place deserves all the praise!
